Senior HR Business Partner – Funzioni aziendali (Svizzera) L'opportunità A Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo è ispirare il prossimo attraverso la costruzione di un futuro energetico sostenibile. Potenziamo case, scuole, ospedali e industrie, ed è la nostra gente che lo rende possibile. Siamo alla ricerca di un partner aziendale HR esperto per supportare le nostre funzioni aziendali in Svizzera. Si tratta di un ruolo altamente operativo e pratico in un ambiente di matrice globale complesso. # Senior HR Business Partner – Corporate Functions (Switzerland) ## The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is **Inspiring the Next through building a sustainable energy future**. We power homes, schools, hospitals and industries—and it's our people who make that possible. We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support our Corporate Functions in Switzerland. This is a highly operational, hands-on role in a complex, global matrix environment. ## Mansioni - Act as a key HR contact for Corporate Function leaders for employees based in Switzerland, providing practical, day-to-day support - Ensure effective HR operations across the employee lifecycle, delivered consistently and in line with policy - Guide stakeholders through complex HR topics, connecting them with the right Centres of Excellence (CoEs) and HR experts - Collaborate closely with global HRBPs, CoEs, and specialist teams to deliver integrated solutions - Build trusted relationships with multiple senior stakeholders, balancing perspectives and priorities - Apply strong political awareness and organisational understanding to navigate sensitive topics effectively - Ensure full compliance with Swiss employment legislation and local regulatory requirements - Work confidently with works councils/employee representative bodies - Support delivery of talent, performance, and organisational processes in partnership with HR colleagues - Use data and insight to support pragmatic, solution-oriented decision-making - Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and shared accountability across HR ##
• Requisiti - 8+ years' relevant HR experience, including operating at HRBP level within a multinational, matrix organisation - Excellent knowledge of Swiss employment legislation and local HR practices (essential), including German language fluency - Experience working with works councils/employee representatives - Proven ability to manage multiple senior stakeholders in a complex environment - Comfortable working within a CoE model, partnering with global HRBP communities and shared services - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a pragmatic and solution-focused mindset - High level of political awareness and ability to navigate organisational complexity - Collaborative approach—able to connect people, teams, and expertise to resolve issues effectively - Experience supporting Corporate Functions or similarly structured environments is advantageous ##
• Cosa offriamo - Join a purpose-driven organisation shaping the future of sustainable energy - Work in a truly global and collaborative HR environment - Be part of a team that values diversity, transparency, and continuous improvement - Gain exposure to complex, high-impact organisational challenges - Develop your career within a leading international organisation ## Note importante - This is an operational HRBP role, focused on delivery and execution rather than strategic design - You must have the right to work in Switzerland - Relocation support is not provided for this position

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Sustainability starts at the design table—and this role puts you right at the center of that impact. As the Engineering Design Sustainability Lead , you will shape how sustainability is embedded into global engineering decisions across our transformer business. This is a highly visible, strategic role where engineering excellence meets environmental responsibility. You will lead the shift from downstream sustainability activities to design‑led outcomes, ensuring product‑level carbon reduction, material optimization, and environmental performance are built into every design choice from the outset. You will work across global engineering teams to translate sustainability ambitions into measurable, auditable product outcomes—balancing cost, safety, quality, and performance. With increasing expectations from customers, regulators, and stakeholders for credible product‑level data, your work will directly support compliance, ESG reporting, and long‑term business resilience. If you thrive at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability—and enjoy influencing without direct authority—this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainable product design at scale. How you'll make an impact Define and drive a global, design‑led sustainability strategy within Engineering. Embed sustainability into engineering standards, processes, and decision frameworks. Reduce product‑level carbon footprint through smart design, material, and architecture choices. Establish sustainability targets, KPIs, and traceable product‑level data at BOM level. Partner across engineering, R&D, supply chain, digital and operations teams globally. Strengthen governance, reporting, and audit‑ready sustainability metrics. Build capability and foster ownership of sustainable design within engineering teams. Translate regulatory and customer sustainability expectations into engineering requirements. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or a closely related sustainability discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in sustainability‑focused roles. Proven success delivering design‑led sustainability or product carbon reduction initiatives. Strong knowledge of lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and carbon accounting. Experience leading global, cross‑functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making. More about us At Hitachi Energy , sustainability, innovation, and safety are core to how we design the future of energy. You'll work in a global, diverse environment where ideas are valued and impact is visible.
• We offer meaningful opportunities to grow, lead, and shape industry‑leading solutions with purpose.

## Descrizione The Global Sustainability Market Engagement Manager enables the organisation to systematically anticipate, structure, and respond to sustainability-related customer and stakeholder expectations. The role supports the transition from reactive, ad-hoc handling of sustainability requests to a proactive, structured, and insight-driven approach, by developing shared response processes, facilitating cross-functional alignment, and translating external market signals into strategic sustainability intelligence. ##
• Responsibilities - **Market & Stakeholder Sustainability Intelligence Capture, consolidate, and structure sustainability-related expectations, requirements, and emerging topics from customers and other relevant stakeholders (e.g. regulators, investors, rating agencies). Identify recurring themes, trends, and early signals with potential relevance for market access, competitiveness, and organisational risk. Maintain a transparent and evolving overview of sustainability topics that are material or increasingly relevant from a market and stakeholder perspective.** - **Sustainability Request & Response Process Development Develop, implement, and continuously improve a structured process for managing sustainability-related customer and stakeholder requests, in collaboration with relevant internal functions. Clarify intake, coordination, prioritisation, escalation, and response pathways to ensure consistency, efficiency, and clarity. Support definition of interfaces, roles, and ways of working across Sustainability, Marketing & Sales, Portfolio, Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Legal, and other functions, while respecting existing governance and decision rights.** - **Enable Consistent and Proactive Market Engagement Support the development of guidance, reference materials, and response frameworks for recurring sustainability topics. Help shift the organisation from case-specific responses to anticipating and preparing for sustainability expectations likely to arise in future customer engagements. Facilitate alignment on external sustainability messaging and positioning across regions and businesses.** - **Strategic Insight & Material Topic Input Synthesise market-derived sustainability insights and provide structured input to support: Sustainability strategy discussions Identification and prioritisation of material sustainability topics Portfolio, offering, and capability development considerations Contribute fact-based insights on how external sustainability expectations evolve and what this implies for the organisation.** - **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement Act as a connecting interface between the Sustainability function and customer-facing as well as enabling functions. Support Marketing & Sales and account teams with sustainability insights and background, particularly in strategic or complex customer contexts. Vous travaillerez à travers un écosystème sophistiqué de produits dont EMS, ADMS, DERMS et vous assurerez que nos applications de puissance sont alignées, évolutives et prêtes à l'avenir. L'un des principaux objectifs de ce rôle est d'identifier les possibilités de changement de jeu pour appliquer l'IA dans l'analyse des systèmes d'alimentation électrique, en redéfinissant ce qui est possible pour les opérations du réseau mondial. Comment vous ferez un impact - Définir et piloter la vision du produit, la feuille de route et la stratégie à long terme pour les applications de puissance dans le portefeuille NC - Diriger le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, depuis les exigences et la conception jusqu'à la mise à l'essai, à la libération et après le lancement - Former et développer des applications avancées telles que l'estimation de l'état, le flux de puissance (équilibré et déséquilibré), l'analyse de sécurité, la stabilité transitoire, l'évaluation dynamique et le flux de puissance optimal - Collaborer avec les équipes mondiales de R-D, de ventes, de préventes, de marketing et de service à la clientèle afin de prioriser les caractéristiques et d'assurer une livraison réussie - Identifier et promouvoir des innovations pilotées par l'IA qui révolutionnent l'analyse et l'optimisation du système d'alimentation en temps réel - Forte expérience de la gestion des produits, de préférence dans les systèmes d'alimentation, les services publics ou les portefeuilles de logiciels complexes - Compréhension approfondie des applications d'analyse de système d'alimentation telles que le débit d'alimentation, l'analyse de stabilité, l'analyse de sécurité et l'optimisation - Capacité éprouvée de travailler interfonctionnellement dans un environnement global et matriciel - L'état d'esprit stratégique combiné avec des compétences pratiques d'exécution tout au long du cycle de vie du produit - Passion d'innovation, avec un fort intérêt pour l'IA et l'analyse avancée appliquée aux systèmes énergétiques - Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes, y compris l'expérience client - Capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en stratégies de produits claires et en valeur opérationnelle Plus sur nous Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'une organisation diversifiée, collaborative et ciblée où votre travail a un impact réel, et vos idées aident à façonner les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

descriptionByLocale.it: Job Description The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient industrial specialist with expertise in power system analysis\/ management and high-level programming. In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You create impact: Together with your team design innovative approaches for grid operation and deliver them as robust software modules You investigate: Translate real power‑system problems into rigorous models and final solutions for the customers You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and inter-disciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy to drive the development from concept to production You connect: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, start-ups, and vendors to integrate diverse perspectives and stakeholder inputs You communicate: Be able to clearly communicate concepts to software developers, implementation engineering teams and customers. Produce clear design docs and developer-facing examples\/ notebooks that enable reuse. Your background Master Electrical\/Power Systems Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience Proven expertise in modelling and steady-state analyses of power grids demonstrated hands-on expertise applying these methods in software development. Knowledge in mathematical optimization applied to power systems, and modern numerical solvers is strongly desired (e.g., MIP\/NLP, stochastic; tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Ipopt). Experience with machine learning and\/or artificial intelligence technologies is a plus Proficiency in C#, C++, Rust or a similar high-level programming language is required; Python and\/or Matlab for analytics and fast prototyping are a plus. Experience building state-of-the-art software engineering techniques (version control, code reviews, testing, CI\/CD) and integrating solution algorithms into applications are beneficial (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). High performance computing skills such as parallel\/distributed computing, GPU, OpenMP or MPI would be beneficial Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out. We can provide more information during the recruitment process. Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? descriptionByLocale.it: Join Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business as our Global Head of Sales. The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
